blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. on Friday said the government is expanding the use of solar-powered irrigation systems as the Super El Niño looms. He made the remarks during the inauguration of the Tugbong Solar Pump Irrigation Project (SPIP) in Barangay Tugbong, Kananga, Leyte. READ: Palace: Collect rainwater from Super Typhoon Rosal “Now, all these efforts have become more important,” Marcos said in his speech. “That is why I am going around the country and ensuring that our irrigation systems are in good condition because El Niño is approaching and has become a growing concern,” he noted.
